Christopher Garner, Vice President  Hurley Owens, Commissioner
Devin Ablard, Commissioner

Giselle Rodriguez, Legal Office Assistant  Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:29 AM, Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney, called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Ablard, Gallardo Good, Garner, Morales, Owens

 Also present: Gary Anderson, Assistant City Attorney, Giselle Rodriguez, Legal Office Assistant,
 Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist.

 ELECTION OF PRESIDENT AND VICE PRESIDENT

 A motion was made by Commissioner Garner, to nominate Commissioner Morales for
 President of the Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission. The
 motion carried by the following vote:

 Yes:  5  Ablard, Gallardo Good, Garner, Morales, Owens
 No:  0  None
 Recused:  0  None
 Abstain:  0  None
 Absent:  0  None

 A motion was made by Commissioner Morales, to nominate Commissioner Garner for Vice
 President of the Civil Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission. The
 motion carried by the following vote:

 Yes:  5  Ablard, Gallardo Good, Garner, Morales, Owens
 No:  0  None
 Recused:  0  None
 Abstain:  0  None
 Absent:  0  None

Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, declared the nominations open for President.

Commissioner Garner nominated Commissioner Morales for President of the Civil Service Employee
Rights and Appeals Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, declared the
nominations closed for President.

Commissioner Morales spoke.

Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, declared the nominations open for Vice President.

Commissioner Morales nominated Commissioner Garner for Vice President of the Civil Service
Employee Rights and Appeals Commission.

Commissioner Gallardo Good nominated Commissioner Gallardo Good for Vice President of the Civil
Service Employee Rights and Appeals Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Phillip McGowan, City Clerk Specialist, declared the
nominations closed for Vice President.

Commissioner Garner spoke.

Commissioner Gallardo Good spoke.

  Commissioner Gallardo Good, to approve recommendation. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Ablard, Gallardo Good, Garner, Morales, Owens
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
